definitions.explanation: The deeper, hidden, or underlying layer of something. Used both literally (deep layers of the ocean, earth, or skin) and figuratively (the depths of the mind, underlying causes of phenomena).

examples.japanese: {深層|しんそう}{心理|しんり}を{探|さぐ}る。
examples.english: To explore the depths of the psyche.

examples.japanese: {問題|もんだい}の{深層|しんそう}にある{原因|げんいん}を{突|つ}き{止|と}める{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: We need to identify the root cause underlying the problem.

examples.japanese: {深層|しんそう}{学習|がくしゅう}はAI{技術|ぎじゅつ}の{中核|ちゅうかく}を{担|にな}っている。
examples.english: Deep learning plays a central role in AI technology.

notes:
USAGE:
Combines {深|しん} (deep) and {層|そう} (layer, stratum). Used in psychology ({深層|しんそう}{心理|しんり} — deep psychology), oceanography ({深層|しんそう}{水|すい} — deep water), and technology ({深層|しんそう}{学習|がくしゅう} — deep learning). Contrasts with {表層|ひょうそう} (surface layer).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {深層|しんそう}{心理|しんり}: deep psychology, subconscious
- {深層|しんそう}{学習|がくしゅう}: deep learning
- {深層|しんそう}{水|すい}: deep water
- {深層|しんそう}に{潜|ひそ}む: to lurk in the depths
- {深層|しんそう}{意識|いしき}: deep consciousness
